title: Uniswap adds seven trading sources as 0x disputes its protection from malicious hooks
summary: Uniswap Labs launched aggregator hooks on Ethereum, Base, and Robinhood Chain on Oct. 22, letting its web app and API route swaps through external liquidity from Curve, Fluid, PancakeSwap, and other venues. The new adapters were developed by Uniswap Labs.
